title: Free, Open-Source AI Web App for Image & 3D Model Generation
author: fyrean
selftext:
I’ve been working on a free, open-source web app that lets anyone generate AI-powered images and even 3D models, using just a browser. Why? Because most people don’t have the hardware to run local AI models, and I wanted to make these tools more accessible to everyone.

**What It Does:**  
It's packed with features to bring your creative ideas to life, for freeeeee:

* Generate images with free open source AI services like AI Horde and HuggingFace.
* Advanced features: img2img, **inpainting**, **LoRAs**, and **textural inversions**.
* 3D model generation, so you can bring your flat 2D ~~waifus~~ images to life!
* Quality of life stuff:
   * Style presets selection.
   * Inpainting Mask editing.
   * Easy Lora and TI selection thru CivitAI.
   * 3D model viewer
   * Background removal

Here u go: [Just Another AI App](https://justaaa.fyrean.com)

[Sauce code](https://github.com/MangoLion/justaaa)

**How It Works:**

* **AI Horde:** Text-to-image gen service powered by volunteers. No account setup needed; I’ve included a shared key loaded with kudos (thanks to the awesome volunteer network behind AI Horde, though wait times can be long).
* **HuggingFace:** You’ll need your own free key, which gets you about 200 H100 GPU seconds daily. Select from any text-to-image models
* **3D Model Generation:** Powered by [Microsoft TRELLIS](https://github.com/microsoft/TRELLIS), hosted on my personal (potato) PC. It’s free but might be slow during busy times.

**Why Should You Try It?**  
This app is perfect if you’ve been curious about AI-generated content but don’t have a gaming PC or the budget for pricey AI tools. Whether you’re into art, experimenting with 3D models, or just exploring what’s possible with AI, this is for you.

Check out some screenshots below to see how it looks:

* **Model Selection:** Choose from various AI models.

https://preview.redd.it/vmosogjnyw6e1.png?width=1285&format=png&auto=webp&s=9cde237f0887d2f696d50be9b35608c85e395177

* **Style Presets:** Generate consistent results effortlessly.

https://preview.redd.it/emdvniguyw6e1.png?width=1297&format=png&auto=webp&s=63a49303473f271f1c1c0262196cffdfaec32462

* Gallery grid for neat result organization and bookmarking:

https://preview.redd.it/btg4ge7xyw6e1.png?width=1817&format=png&auto=webp&s=0b45730488f26898d427dd84985155dda5dce7d4

* **Inpainting:** Edit specific areas of an image.

https://preview.redd.it/olfgamnxyw6e1.png?width=1461&format=png&auto=webp&s=1ffcee687c06298d7fe5a551639993ba13da7f65

* **3D Model Viewer:** Turn your images into 3D!

https://preview.redd.it/gbqytj4yyw6e1.png?width=825&format=png&auto=webp&s=6b1c9c65806eae121137fbe1fed2af8e8c723f7c

Give it a try, and let me know what you think! Feedback is always welcome. This is a project for the community, so I’m open to ideas for improvement or contributions if you’re a developer.

Let’s make creativity accessible to everyone. 😊

comments.author: PhysicalServe3399
comments.body:
This is an awesome initiative! Making powerful AI image and 3D generation tools accessible through the browser really lowers the barrier for creatives who don’t have high-end hardware.

For folks exploring free or open-source AI creative tools like this, there are also platforms such as Magicshot.ai that offer easy-to-use AI image generation with integrations that suit various workflows. While Magicshot.ai isn’t open-source, it shows how versatile and user-friendly AI-powered creative tools are becoming.

Combining options like your web app with other available AI services can give users a great mix of flexibility, from casual experimentation to more professional-grade outputs. Excited to see where community feedback takes this project — open tools like these are exactly what the creative AI space needs!
